mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicate broad economic weakness that reduces corporate revenue expectations, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and PAYEMS decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and PAYEMS decline, or Rank IC for interaction signal is below 0.03 over 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.5% year-over-year signals inflation-driven monetary tightening risks that increase equity risk premiums, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of late-cycle expansion periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, or Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 2.0% year-over-year indicates rising inflation that erodes real corporate profits and increases equity risk, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.0% YoY, or Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1200 thousand units signal strong consumer demand for housing and related sectors, boosting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment rising above 144000 thousand indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 144000, or Rank IC over 2 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) relative to historical norms indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.03.
